quote: And don't even get me started on the food. People love to mock Skyline Chili because they don't understand it. It’s not Texas chili! It’s a beautifully spiced Mediterranean meat sauce served over spaghetti with a mountain of finely grated cheddar cheese, and if you haven't crushed a 3-Way at 1:00 AM, you haven't truly lived.
